description: Receipt gate and route gate. The receipt gate is a Stop hook that blocks claiming completion while a spec under .fable-advisor/pending/ lacks a complete receipt and no runner is in flight for it. The route gate is a PreToolUse hook that denies an Agent whose subagent_type starts with fable-advisor:, and a SendMessage to such an agent, when the route line does not match the agent file and the Claude Code routing profile. Both fail open without python; pending specs are re-checked once python is available.

hooks.command: payload=$(cat); if py -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=py; elif python3 -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=python3; elif python -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=python; else R=; fi; if [ -n "$R" ]; then printf '%s' "$payload" | "$R" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/receipt-gate.py"; else echo 'fable-advisor receipt gate skipped: python runtime missing (fail open; pending specs are re-checked when a python runtime returns)' >&2; fi

payload=$(cat); if py -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=py; elif python3 -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=python3; elif python -c 'pass' >/dev/null 2>&1; then R=python; else R=; fi; if [ -n "$R" ]; then printf '%s' "$payload" | "$R" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/route-gate.py"; else echo 'fable-advisor route gate skipped: python runtime missing (fail open)' >&2; fi
